title: agenticspec-render-model/1
description: One page of agenticspec-render: a graph of nodes, ports, edges, regions and marks, and panels beside it. agenticspec_render::page::render draws it as one HTML page.

layout.description: graph (the default): rows by the longest chain of edges. bands: one horizontal band per top-level region, top to bottom in the order of regions, each as wide as the page; what a band holds is laid out inside it, an edge between two bands runs through the gaps between them, and nodes in no top-level region fill a last band without a label.

Group.description: The colour and icon of the nodes whose group is name. A group not listed keeps the palette and the plain icon.

Colour.description: A hex colour (# and 3, 4, 6 or 8 hex digits), rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() of 3 or 4 numbers (each optionally followed by % or deg, apart by spaces, commas or a slash), or one of the named colours. Anything else is refused.

Icon.description: One of the icon names, drawn as that stroke icon, or a text of 1 or 2 characters drawn in the icon tile.

Region.description: A box that holds nodes. A region whose id is a node's id is that node's card; any other outermost region is a card of its own. Its nodes are headed 'per <per>', 'in <in>' or 'in <label>'.

collapsed.description: Drawn as one card (its label and the count of the nodes inside it, nested regions included) until it is opened on the page; edges into it are merged per pair of visible ends, labelled with their count. A collapsed region holds at least one node besides its own, or the page is refused (region_collapsed_empty).

region.description: The id of a region, or of a node, the node is drawn in; a page whose node names neither is refused (node_region_unknown).

Badge.description: A pill at the card's top right: 'count' reads '×<value>', any other '<name> <value>'. With on: panel it is a row of the table Details under the graph instead.

node.description: The id of the node the port is a row of; a page whose port names no node is refused (port_node_unknown).

Edge.description: From and to name a node id, or 'node.port' of a port the page declares on that node; a page with an end that names neither is refused (edge_end_unknown). The stroke grows with count: up to 1, 2 or 3, 4 or more.

Mark.description: A refusal (the default) or a piece of information on a node or a port. A refusal rings its card or port. A page whose mark targets no node, or a port the page does not declare on that node, is refused (mark_target_unknown).

place.description: side (the default): in the column beside the graph. below: across the page under the graph.
